text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: ――Now then, let's hear a few words from Symboli Kris S, who had an incredible performance last year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Recognized for her achievements, including winning
the Classic Tenno Sho (Autumn),
Symboli Kris S was doing a special interview.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a Trainer sitting in on this as well—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: —In particular, last year's Tenno Sho (Autumn) was truly magnificent! What are your goals moving forward in the Senior class?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will continue to... do my best... to deliver "results."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
......Um.
I-Is there anything else?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...That is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, the reporter struggled but managed to draw
words out of Symboli Kris S, bringing the special interview
to a successful close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, while taking a break after our meeting
and watching TV, Symboli Kris S happened to be featured on screen—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Symboli Kris S, who showed such dramatic prowess last year,
has been turning heads with her cool composure!"

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
"Look at that composed demeanor!
Has there ever been an Umamusume so calm and collected after winning a GⅠ?!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"She's so cool, isn't she!
Overflowing with something like confidence,
and so dignified!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"At first, I honestly thought she was kind of aloof...
but seeing just how strong she is really makes you admire her."

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text: "We also went around town to hear what everyone had to say about Kris S's condition!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Her stability is amazing. She has that raw power
typical of overseas Umamusume—I hope Japanese Umamusume
won't lose and will do their best too."

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"I often wonder how things would've turned out
if Tanino Gimlet from my generation had been there.
I wonder who my rival would've been."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the program, it feels like Symboli Kris S's
success is being embraced much more warmly
than it was last year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps through the steady accumulation of "results,"
her sincerity had shone through.
That thought made me feel a little... proud.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Did something—good happen?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...She looked happy.
choice_data_list: ...I just felt like I needed to work harder, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our journey through the Senior Class has only just begun.
I made a firm vow in my heart to keep producing "results" together with her from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...The weather is still clear and unchanged, huh.
In that case, proceeding with solo training under Plan A—)
――Are you free now？

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Tap--

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You've been the talk of the town lately, haven't you!
You looked really cool on TV, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, what a natural reaction. Don't you like being praised?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh!
That's not what I came here to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...What is it you need?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Just some chit-chat. Running the Arima Kinen
helped me understand you a bit better than before.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
âNow I'm sure of it.
You and I are alike.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...They resemble each other, you say?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Just so you know, it's not because we're both from abroad or anything like that.
The way we're similar is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We're not afraid of the world's rough seas
that stand in the way of our "romance."
—Basically, we're both the same kind of idiot.

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, over there.
Aren't those two Tap-san and Kris S-san?”

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, what's the situation here?
Is there some tension in the air...!?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Good grief. Normally, I'd welcome a little commotion, but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Shall we change locations?
Right now, I'm only in the mood to share a ride with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: By demonstrating extraordinary strength... and standing at the pinnacle... a "revolution"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to fulfill...
what you call... "romance"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Are you... the same way?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: To change something—to gain something—is she trying to transcend common sense?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kris S.
Do you think "building a giant castle" is impossible in this world?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...It is not—impossible.
However—I consider it to be—extremely difficult.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Do you mean... "by conventional logic"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Right, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What I want to destroy—
What I want to overcome, is something like that...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Hear me, Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: My "Romance" is...!! Building a huge castle where my precious crew and I can live and party forever together!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Laughing with them forever!
Dancing! Goofing around—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And even if we part ways for a time—
I'll build a massive castle so grand I can always say,
"You're welcome to come back here anytime"!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I need money...!
Lots and lots of filthy, boatloads of cash!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"So I've decided! To rake in all that cash,
I'm gonna show myself off to the whole wide world!
Louder and prouder than anyone else!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I—in races, I will shatter every record in this world!
So that everyone knows my name!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"And then I'll seize it! Fame! Fortune!
—And 'Romance'!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—That's how I shatter common sense.
What you might call a 'revolution.'”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How about it?
Exciting, isn't it? Just like the morning of a departure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
……I don't understand it—
It's just—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The form... is different. But... you too... have something you want to achieve... through strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I understand that...
...However—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —As long as you understand that much, it's enough.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're running in this year's Takarazuka Kinen too, right?
To fulfill my own "romance," I'm going to surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you. The one bringing about "revolution"
isn't your coldness—
it's the heat dwelling inside me!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...We're not similar at all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Your words... what was present there...
what I felt for just a fleeting moment—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Let us stop. No more of this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(I will... fulfill my mission.
I should focus... everything on that—)
